header.running_head: Making Congregational Du'aa, Raising the Voice and saying 'Aameen'

blocks.text: Hadhrat Umar (RA) humbling himself before Allaah, wearing simple clothing and a shawl that barely reached his knees. He was seeking Allaah's forgiveness in a loud voice as his tears flowed on to his cheeks. (Rasulullaah ﷺ's uncle) Hadhrat Abbaas bin Abdul Muttalib (RA) was standing on his right side as he faced the Qibla and raised his hands as he sobbed before his Rabb. The people also made du'aa as he made du'aa, after which he took Hadhrat Abbaas (RA)'s hand and said, "O Allaah! Do accept the intercession of Rasulullaah ﷺ's uncle on our behalf." Hadhrat Abaas (RA) then stood beside Hadhrat Umar (RA) for a very long time, his eyes flowing with tears as he made du'aa to Allaah.[^1]
Hadhrat Umar (RA) sits with a group in the Masjid as they all make du'aa one after the other

Hadhrat Abu Sa'eed who was the freed slave of Hadhrat Usayd reports, "Hadhrat Umar (RA) used to patrol the Masjid at night and remove from there everyone besides the person engaged in salaah. When he once passed by a group of Sahabah (RA) amongst whom was Hadhrat Ubay bin Ka'b (RA), he asked, 'Who are you men?' Hadhrat Ubay (RA) replied, 'We are members of your family, O Ameerul Mu'mineen.' 'What kept you behind after the salaah?' Hadhrat Umar (RA) asked. When they informed him that they had been engaged in Dhikr, Hadhrat Umar (RA) sat with them. He then said to the person closest to him, 'Take (the lead in making du'aa).' The man started making du'aa and (when he had completed) Hadhrat Umar (RA) asked each person to make du'aa until he came to me, who was sitting next to him. 'Come on,' he said to me. I was tongue-tied and started to shiver so much until he could actually feel me shake. He then said, '(Say something) Even if you have to only say, 'O Allaah forgive me. O Allaah! Have mercy on me.' Hadhrat Umar (RA) then started making du'aa and there was none who wept more than him. Thereafter, he said, 'That is enough. You may all disperse.'"[^2]
The Du'aa of Hadhrat Habeeb bin Maslamah (RA) and Hadhrat Nu'maan bin Muqarrin (RA)

Hadhrat Abu Hurayrah (RA) narrates that Hadhrat Habeeb bin Maslamah Fahri (RA) was a person whose du'aas were always accepted. When he was once appointed commander of an army and after making the necessary preparations, he was facing the Roman army when he said to the others, "I have heard Rasulullaah ﷺ say, 'When a group assembles and they all say 'Aameen' as one of them makes du'aa, Allaah certainly acts the du'aa.'" He then duly praised Allaah and said, "O Allaah! Protect our blood and still grant us the reward of martyrs." He was still making du'aa when the commander of the Roman army entered Hadhrat Habeeb (RA)'s tent (to surrender).[^3]
Tabraani. Haythami (Vol.10 Pg.170) has commented on the chain of narrators.
